exposure: absence of a neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
Availability of perinatal care equipment and medicines
outcome: Utilization of WHO's Essential Newborn Care (ENC) programme items
cohort: 23,894 postnatal women and their newborn babies in Brazil
finding: Utilization of ENC items was low in Brazil and associated with various factors, including maternal characteristics (adolescent age, low education level, inadequate antenatal care) and hospital structure (lack of NICU, inadequate equipment/medicines).
mod_finding: Caesarean deliveries were associated with less frequent use of partograph, early skin-to-skin contact, and breastfeeding in the first hour after birth.
